purpose: Source-overlay integrity and scope check; not a semantic or linguistic test.

manual_source_checks.separator: Editorial comma is explicitly not asserted to be an ancient divider.

verdict: Pass at stated source-control scope. This verifies faithful preservation and qualification, not a translation.
